messages:
Dana Chen: Heads-up — PolarCloud (regional marketplace) + EdgeFoundry SI want to co-announce our hosted listing + SI integration. Need a quick cadence: legal, launch comms, and tech checklist. Who can sync today?
Jorge Morales: I can take legal gating. key points: redistribution clause, export controls, and KMS responsibilities. Need partner contract draft.
Mei Lin: Product: we need SKU mapping for the marketplace, a short feature matrix, and a demo flow for the SI to validate. Can we reuse the Marketplace SKU template?
Alex Rivera: Eng: will surface a lightweight E2E test plan for the SI. Need staging creds and network diagram from EdgeFoundry. Also confirm quantized model variant allowed for hosted listing.
Priya Shah: Solutions: I'll coordinate SI playbook + customer-facing runbook. Also want a joint webinar slot — PolarCloud prefers week of May 6.
Dana Chen: Great. Action items: Jorge contract draft, Mei sku + matrix, Alex test plan, Priya webinar probe. Can we hit a partner-ready state by May 1?
Jorge Morales: Tentative yes, but need input on liability limits. @Dana can you get PolarCloud's legal contact?
Dana Chen: Sent the contact in DM to Jorge. PolarCloud legal is "Renee T."
Mei Lin: SKU proposal (draft):
```
marketplace_sku: POLAR-REDWOOD-HOSTED-1
billing_unit: monthly-seat
features: [hosted-inference, model-versioning, dedicated-vcpu-burst]
compatibility: EdgeFoundry-SI-v1
```
Is that enough?
Priya Shah: That looks fine. Add a note about demo quotas and rate limits. We should also include recommended batch/quant profiles.
Alex Rivera: For E2E, minimal checklist:
1) auth via PolarCloud marketplace token
2) KMS handshake using our customer-supplied key (if requested)
3) inference latency smoke test (p95 < 280ms)
4) SI-run validation scenario (sample prompt set)
I'll push a skeleton to the partner repo.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Staging env "polar-staging" created at polar-staging.redwood.internal by infra+1
Dana Chen: Timeline question: embargo for joint announcement? PolarCloud suggests coordinated publish same day across marketplace listing + SI case study. Press ops prefers 48h embargo window. Thoughts?
Jorge Morales: 48h is fine. Need to ensure we don't promise SLA levels before contract signed. Include fallback phrasing in announcement.
Mei Lin: Ops note: make sure Dedicated vs Hosted SKU language is explicit. Customers sometimes confuse reserved capacity with hosted listing.
Priya Shah: I'll write the joint blurb draft and loop in press ops. Will include webinar CTA and SI contact.
Alex Rivera: One more tech ask: EdgeFoundry will want a small on-prem demo package. Can we provide a dockerized minimal runner and a quantized weights bundle?
Dana Chen: Yes — Alex, can your team produce the runner and a short install script for SI by Apr 26?
Alex Rivera: We can. ETA Apr 26.
Jorge Morales: I've started a short addendum template for redistribution + export. Putting in drive now, will share link.
Priya Shah: Also confirm who will be the announcement owner on our side. I can own coordination but want press ops to own copy.
Dana Chen: Assigning coordination to Priya; press ops copy owner TBD. I'll schedule a 30m sync with PolarCloud + EdgeFoundry tomorrow.
Mei Lin: Ping me after the sync; I'll update SKU doc accordingly.
Dana Chen: Thanks team — quick and tight. :rocket:
Priya Shah: 👍 I'll open calendar invite and attach the draft blurb.
infra-bot: reminder: add partner IP allowlist for polar-staging in firewall rules (ticket INF-4423)
